title: SourceDocument
description: Immutable retrieved order, schedule, circular or notification. See docs/data/INDIA_CI_TARIFF_DATA_STRATEGY.md section 5.1 and 8.1.

document_id.description: Unique, stable identifier for this immutable document snapshot.

source_id.description: Identifier of the AuthoritativeSource (registry/sources.yaml) this was retrieved from.

url.description: URL the document was retrieved from. Not assumed to remain stable or resolvable.

sha256.description: Content hash of the retrieved document, used to detect silent replacement.

storage_uri.description: Location of the preserved original in immutable object storage or release assets.

supersedes_document_id.description: document_id of a prior document this one amends, corrects or replaces.
